title: Midday triage jotter - console incidents
content:
Midday quick brain-dump for console/observability triage. Not polished — personal checklist + notes to action later.

TODAY (3/13) goals
- clear high-priority customer tickets (CUST-9876, CUST-9901)
- unblock dashboard regression affecting partial-metrics view
- capture repro steps for INF-2543 and hand off to release-eng if infra change needed

PRIORITY ITEMS
1) CUST-9876 - "missing api call graphs" (customer: AcmePay)
   - symptom: graphs blank on >1 minute queries, UI shows 502 for /metrics/query endpoint intermittently
   - first triage: repro on staging (yes) when payload includes long label list (>120 labels)
   - temporary workaround: ask customer to reduce label selectors / use time-windowed query
   - hypothesis: NGINX upstream timeout + observability backend falling back to 502 when response delayed by batching job
   - next: add logs from nginx-access/staging, check proxy timeout (nginx conf), capture full request/response (Ethan to help)
   - linked ticket: INF-2543 (possible runtime fix)

2) Dashboard partial-metrics regression
   - reported by internal QA: heatmap layer doesn't render after switching time-range quickly
   - repro steps I used: open dashboard > heatmap > change range from 1h -> 7d -> 15m quickly -> orange spinner then blank tile
   - console logs: uncaught promise rejection in heatmap-tiles fetch (500 server response)
   - quick mitigation: add retry + graceful placeholder in front-end (temporary)
   - longer term: investigate backend batch cancellation behavior when queries are canceled mid-flight (maybe KV cache invalidation?)
   - assignee: Priya to draft frontend hotfix branch, I'll create ticket for backend investigation

OTHER NOTES / LOW PRIORITY
- Incident window last night (02:12-02:20 UTC) — SRE already filed postmortem stub (PM-422). Confirm if any linkage to dedicated node maintenance.
- Observed increase in 429s on embeddings route at 11:00 PST; might be autoscale lag on dedicated pools. Check dedicated metrics dashboard + allocation logs.

QUICK COMMANDS / TOOLS I RAN
- kubectl logs -n observability svc/metrics-backend-1 --since=30m | grep "timeout"
- curl -v -X POST https://staging.console.redwood.ai/metrics/query -d @payload.json -o /tmp/resp.txt; cat /tmp/resp.txt | jq .
- gh pr checkout 412 && yarn dev:console --trace-warnings (reproduce heatmap empty tile locally)

UNRESOLVED QUESTIONS
- Is there an existing nginx timeout override for large query payloads? (ask infra)
- Does the backend cancel in-flight batches or simply let them finish? (ask serving-runtime team)
- Should we throttle complex queries at the API layer instead of letting them hit backend hard? (product discussion)

ACTIONS (short list)
- [ ] Add staging nginx access logs to INF-2543 (Isabella) — due EOD
- [ ] Create frontend placeholder + retry PR for heatmap (Priya) — target: today afternoon
- [ ] Confirm autoscale events around 11:00 PST and attach timeline to CUST-9901 (Ethan)
- [ ] Draft short note to CS about workaround to share with customer (Isabella)

MESSAGING / SLACK BLURB (copy/paste)
"Hey @channel — quick update: investigating intermittent blank graphs for AcmePay. Workaround: use smaller label selectors/time-window. Root cause suspicion: upstream timeout when payloads contain large label sets. Will post repro + logs in #console-triage once available.
If you have observed similar failures this morning, please drop timestamps + request ids here."

PERSONAL REMINDERS
- don't forget to add reproduction timestamps to ticket (makes SRE life easier)
- keep customer updates short: state mitigation + ETA for fix (no technical rabbit holes in first message)
- file follow-up to add an e2e test that exercises "large label list" scenario in QA harness

THINGS TO DO LATER THIS WEEK
- pair with Priya on a small frontend hotfix (timeboxed 2-3 hours)
- set up a short runbook snippet for common console triage flows (copy examples into confluence page)
- explore whether caching prefix optimization could cover the long label queries (talk to serving-runtime + optimize)

SNIPPETS / CLIPBOARD (quick copyables)
- Repro curl payload path: /tmp/triage/payload-large-labels.json
- Jira quick links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2543, https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CUST-9876

End of jotter. Will tidy into ticket comments and send customer note after confirm logs.
